title: Show HN: Homebrew 6.0.0
summary: Homebrew 6.0.0 is a major release of the popular macOS/Linux package manager, featuring a new tap trust security mechanism, a faster internal JSON API, Linux sandboxing support, and initial macOS 27 (Golden Gate) compatibility.
problem_solved: Provides secure, convenient package management for macOS and Linux systems with improved trust verification and performance.
why_valuable: This release significantly improves security through the new tap trust mechanism and enhances performance with a streamlined JSON API, while expanding platform support.
